calculation.expression: prod(1 + r_i - beta_i*r_benchmark) - 1 over trailing 80 sessions, lagged one completed day
calculation.description: Rolling 80-session beta-neutralized cumulative momentum relative to the equal-weight mean return of the 15 tradable assets; shifted one completed day before use.

validation.regime_notes: Positive in 2023-24 (IC 0.036514, ICIR 1.5622), but negative in 2020-22 (-0.010835), 2025-26 (-0.000148), and recent 2026-07-16 through 2027-02-24 (-0.037075, ICIR -1.9964); admitted numerically but requires cautious monitoring.
